You can, but you only need the HTML file for what we're doing.

Download Homeboard v1.1 (index.html)

Here's what to do:

  1. Download index.html to your laptop.

  2. Open GitHub and create a new repository named portal-homeboard.

  3. Upload index.html to the repository.

  4. Go to Settings → Pages.

  5. Under Build and deployment, choose Deploy from a branch.

  6. Select main and /(root), then save.

GitHub will give you a website address that looks like:

https://YOURUSERNAME.github.io/portal-homeboard/

That's the address you'll open in your Portal+'s browser.

You don't need to download the ZIP package unless you want the extra setup instructions.
